shortDesc: SAP B1 sales order line view (ORDR/RDR1). Document, customer, item lines, tax-inclusive/exclusive amounts and open amounts. Base for order amount, ticket size, booking volume; supports aggregation by customer, item, salesperson, period, branch.

SAP B1 delivery line view (ODLN/DLN1). Document, customer, item lines, quantity, tax-inclusive amount, warehouse. Base for delivery quantity and fulfillment metrics; supports analysis by warehouse and customer group.

SAP B1 AR invoice line view (OINV/INV1). Issued customer invoices: document, customer, item lines, tax-inclusive amount, tax rate, settlement status. Core source for net sales, billed revenue, tax; supports analysis by period, customer, account.

SAP B1 sales return line view (ORDN/RDN1). Return documents, return reason, item lines, negative amount. Core for return amount and return rate; supports analysis by return reason, item group, customer for quality or over-commitment issues.
SAP B1 AR credit memo line view (ORIN/RIN1). Reverses or adjusts AR invoices; negative amounts and linked invoice. With OINV, used for net AR, credit adjustments, and customer credit analysis.

SAP B1 goods receipt (PO) line view (OPDN/PDN1). Purchase receipts: document, vendor, item lines, received quantity, cost (excl./incl. tax). Base for purchase cost and receipt volume; supports analysis by vendor, item group, warehouse, period.
SAP B1 purchase return line view (ORPD/RPD1). Returns to vendor: document, item lines, negative cost. Used with OPDN for net receipt volume and vendor return rate; supports vendor quality analysis.

SAP B1 inventory view: OnHand, OnOrder, IsCommited, Available, AvgPrice by item and warehouse. Base for inventory turnover, safety stock, and out-of-stock risk; supports analysis by warehouse, item group, branch.

SAP B1 journal entry view: account code/name, debit/credit, local amount, period. Base for gross margin and cost analysis; supports drill-down by account, period, cost center, project for P&L and anomaly detection.
